modules.purpose: Vercel AI SDK v6 orchestration layer (replaces Python Claude Agent SDK). Manages agent sessions, tool execution, multi-provider LLM routing, and all AI-powered features.
Agent lifecycle management: queue routing, worker thread spawning, state tracking, and event dispatch for task execution.
40+ Electron IPC endpoints: agent events, settings, project ops, GitHub/GitLab, terminal, memory, insights, changelog, and more. Main↔Renderer bridge.
PTY daemon + lifecycle management. Full terminal integration with Claude agent support and xterm.js renderer bridge.
Cross-platform abstraction: OS detection, executable lookup, path resolution, shell detection. Enforces portable code patterns.
Multi-account credential management: OAuth token refresh, usage monitoring, rate-limit-aware profile switching, OS keychain integration.
React 19 UI: components, Zustand stores (24+ types), hooks, styles (7 themes with light/dark), and contexts for desktop app.
GitHub integration UI, including issue analyzer, PR review orchestrator, and error parser utilities.
Shared types (19+ files), i18n locales (en/fr), constants, and utility functions for cross-cutting concerns.
Agent system prompts: planner, coder (+ recovery), QA reviewer/fixer, spec pipeline (gather/assess/write/critic), GitHub/GitLab specialized agents (15+ PR/issue prompts).
Multi-provider adapter registry: Anthropic (primary), OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, Azure, Mistral, Groq, xAI, Ollama. Token normalization, thinking budget mgmt, prompt caching.
Build pipeline orchestration: planner → coder → QA with recovery paths, parallel subagent spawning, and task context injection.
Specialized agents for GitHub: PR review, issue triage, codebase fit analysis, finding validation, followup resolution, logic checks.
Specification creation pipeline: researcher → assessor → writer → critic. AI-driven complexity assessment and requirement gathering.
8 builtin tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch) with Zod schemas via AI SDK tool() API.
Bash command validator, command parser, and path containment. Ported from Python with identical allowlist behavior.
Model Context Protocol client integration via @ai-sdk/mcp. MCP server lifecycle and tool discovery.
Graphiti-based semantic memory: graph-based knowledge retention via Python MCP sidecar, configured through settings UI.
Release notes generation from completed tasks and git history. Markdown-to-HTML rendering.
Playwright E2E tests for desktop app. Can run in debug mode via Electron MCP for AI self-validation.
CI/CD automation: build, test, package for macOS/Windows/Linux, release on PR merge to main.
Job ingestion pipeline feature (Python tests: test_pipeline, test_job_standardizer, test_exporters, test_program_mapper). Status unknown: ready-to-ship, WIP, or parked?
10 patch files (0001-0010) for ClearanceJobs contact pipeline. Untracked; PII concerns pending audit → decision (commit/split/ignore).
Nested git repo (own reconcile, own emit). Out of scope for this repo's mapping; covered by separate WS-BD-AUTOMATION-ENGINE-NESTED workstream emit.
